    PublishConfirm.fromWaitForConfirms(boolean allConfirmed)
    Maps the boolean returned by Channel.waitForConfirms(...) to a confirm outcome: true (every outstanding publish was ack'd) becomes ACKED, false (at least one was nack'd) becomes NACKED.

    RabbitMqService.publishConfirmed(String exchange, String routingKey, String body, long timeoutMs)
    Publishes body like RabbitMqService.publish(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String), then waits for a publisher confirm from the broker and reports whether it was ACKED, NACKED or TIMEOUT.
